lines.zh: 到了那时，这场始于地球浅海的远征，
lines.en: By then, this voyage that began in the shallow seas of Earth

lines.zh: 早已跨越无数代形体与心智。
lines.en: will long since have crossed countless generations of body and mind.

lines.zh: 最初出发的生命，无法想象最后的旅人；
lines.en: The first life to set out could never imagine the last traveler;

lines.zh: 最后的旅人，却仍可能记得出发的地方：
lines.en: yet the last traveler may still remember where it all began:

lines.zh: 一个在寒夜里抬头望天的人。
lines.en: and someone who, on a cold night, looked up at the sky.

lines.zh: 我们曾把从一颗星球上诞生的黎明，带过了群星的黄昏。
lines.en: we carried the dawn born on a single planet across the twilight of the stars.
